lineage.method_source: CLARE, Fu, Lou, Liao & Yu, arXiv:2609.17026 (BMVC 2026)

model.tokenizer: same directory (tokenizer.json aeb13307..., tokenizer_config.json d5d09f07...; pins in titan_model_soup_mini_v1/soup.py ASSETS)
model.architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 28 layers, hidden 1024, intermediate 3072, vocab 151936, tied embeddings
model.storage: bfloat16 (as published; exact FP32 upcast at compute time)

footprint.rationale: Titan's native block range (8-27). MLP matrices only, so a DENSE AdamW state (arms A/B, the E discovery probe) fits on the 8 GB card without host offload; attention and norms are frozen in every arm. Registered restriction, not a claim that skills live only in MLPs.

dataset.note: read in place (never copied); every file verified against the manifest before use; the verifier is loaded with bytecode writing disabled

train.banks: manifests/atomic_{R,U,S,P}.json (3,000 rows each, all four on the same 3,000 parent worlds)
train.row_order: ascending sha256('CLARE-RINEYA-001|order|<seed>|<skill>|<row id>'); first rows_per_skill rows; identical across arms
train.target: oracle references[0] (canonical compact JSON). Declared deviation: the corpus was designed for online RL; this study uses SFT on one valid certificate.
train.loss: assistant answer tokens + <|im_end|> (Titan contract, vendored compile_row); prompt rendered with enable_thinking=False
train.update_grouping: vendored group_updates, <= 2048 tokens per update, order-preserving

lr_pilot.rule: OUTCOME-BLIND BUILD GATE, run before any arm: train skill R dense (arm-A stage 1 recipe) at peak_lr 1e-5; score CALIBRATION R rows (150). If accuracy <= base accuracy + 0.10, repeat at 3e-5, then 1e-4, then stop. Freeze the first LR that clears the bar for EVERY arm. If none clears it, CLARE-RINEYA-001 is BLOCKED on acquisition (not a negative result). Uses CALIBRATION (train signatures only) and never DEV/TEST.

discovery.l1_form: decoupled proximal soft-threshold after each AdamW step, threshold = lr_t * l1_lambda (Adam-scale; CLARE's 1e-4 is SGD-scale and does not transfer)
discovery.importance: |delta_j| at the end of the probe (CLARE Eq. 5), free coordinates only
discovery.selection: exact budget; ties broken by seeded hash, then global index (deviation: CLARE includes all threshold ties)
discovery.reset: discard every probe value and the probe optimiser; verified by effective-weight checksum
discovery.lambda_gate: OUTCOME-BLIND, applied per skill inside arm E (TRAIN rows only; reads only the probe's non-zero count): if the probe leaves fewer than 2x budget non-zero free coordinates, the probe is reset and repeated with the next lambda_fallback value; every attempt is recorded in the skill manifest

evaluation.decoding: greedy, batch 1, KV cache, max_new_tokens 64, stop at any of EOS ids [151645, 151643]; EOS not part of the response
evaluation.scorer: MAXRL-COMP-002 verifier.score (strict JSON, any valid certificate)
evaluation.schedule: base: all 15 signatures; after each stage k of an arm: the 4 atomic signatures + every signature whose skills are all learned by stage k; the final stage scores all 15

interaction.bank: the first 32 DEV-sample rows of the pair's own signature (RU, US, SP seen; RS, RP, UP held-out)
estimators: I_lp per row (unclipped teacher-forced log-prob of the reference)
full-vocab and top-k-restricted log-softmax interaction norms

general_retention.instrument: n=47 retention panel (monitor_probe.jsonl sha 5f6df1c1..., reference receipt content ec3fca1e..., implementation_digest a329eb7b)
general_retention.statistic: retained = 47 - lost_total (Supa-correct denominator); report arm_correct_outside_source separately; format/value channels split via lenient_value_present
general_retention.status: SECONDARY; requires an operator decision because the probe writes into another session's worktree
